newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Thousands protest in Mongolia on work conditions.
newsitem.headline: Thousands protest in Mongolia on work conditions.

text.p: More than 5,000 people gathered in Mongolia's capital on Wednesday and handed a petition to the government demanding better working conditions in mines and factories and payment of promised pension increases.

In a demonstration organised by the Mongolia Trade Union Association, pensioners, trade union members and workers from coal mines around Ulan Bator massed in the city's main Sukh Bator square outside parliament.
An announcement on Sunday that the government was raising electricity prices by 31 percent and central heating by 10 percent had sparked the protest, witnesses said.

Pensioners were protesting against what they said was the failure of the government to fulfil a promise made shortly after it was elected last June to increase pensions, they said. Workers had been angered by an announcement last month that pensions of employees working in such dangerous industries as coal and copper mining would be increased, they said.
They were demanding immediate action to ensure safer working conditions rather than financial rewards after retirement when their health was already damaged, they said.
The demonstrators dispersed after handing in the petition, witnesses said.
